note: Both sets share similar errors, such as misclassifying the 2'-4" First Floor elevation as a horizontal dimension and incorrectly labeling the 9'-0" story height as an elevation. Both also misattribute the 2'-0" dimension to the West Elevation (it belongs to the North Elevation). However, Set B is superior because it captures critical engineering data that Set A misses, specifically the T.O. Steel elevation (11'-4") and the major 32'-0" span dimension. Set A contains more redundant claims (e.g., multiple entries for HSS and Plate sizes) without adding unique value.
